text: 年初至今，北证50指数跌幅超27%，显著跑输各大股指；这只曾经半年涨幅超160%的热门指数，自历史高点算起回撤幅度已经超过34%。国庆节后将有8只北交所主题基金开启发行，有基金经理分析指出，在当前成交清淡、情绪冰封的阶段，正是利用新发产品从容进行左侧建仓的关键窗口。（证券时报）
text_en: Year to date, the BSE 50 Index has fallen more than 27%, significantly underperforming major stock indexes; this once-hot index, which rose more than 160% in half a year, has retreated more than 34% from its historical high. After the National Day holiday, eight Beijing Stock Exchange-themed funds will begin issuance, and one fund manager noted that at a stage of thin trading and frozen sentiment, this is precisely a key window to use newly launched products to calmly build positions on the left side. (Securities Times)
